name: Power over Poison
summary: In Darnassus, Power over Poison brings a young druid back to finish the Cenarion Circle's trial. It began in Darkshore, where the initiate learned to brew a remedy by hand.

sections.title: The Student's Humility
sections.body: In Darkshore, Alanndarian Nightsong sends young druids to gather Earthroot and Lunar Fungus by hand. They use them to brew a salve for stricken wildlife. Before teaching the magic that purges toxins, the Cenarion Circle asks initiates to learn the hardship of treating poison without spiritual aid. That work shows them what common folk endure when venom strikes, and why a druid must meet their suffering with care.

sections.title: Return to the Enclave
sections.body: The remedy proves effective in Auberdine, and Starblaze sends the druid across the sea to Darnassus. Mathrengyl Bearwalker waits in the Cenarion Enclave. Pleased by the initiate's grace under pressure, he teaches them to cleanse toxins through nature's power. Yet virulent poisons in the wilds around Auberdine trouble him. They point to an unnatural blight that disturbs the land's balance.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The trial prepares a druid to cure poison with magic after first making a salve by hand. From Darkshore, the student returns to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus to learn Cure Poison.

Dendrite Starblaze is an elder druid at Nighthaven in Moonglade. He guides initiates through spiritual trials that test their patience and dedication to nature, then sends them to their home trainers.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a master druid trainer in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. Beneath Teldrassil's boughs, he trains night elf druids in forms, restorative arts, and the duties of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Why was the druid required to make a cure by hand first?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze teaches druids to understand poison's physical toll and the work of treating it without magic. Gathering ordinary ingredients and tending the sick by hand teaches humility and gratitude for the natural gifts they are about to receive.

faq.q: What concerns Mathrengyl about the situation in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl finds the lethal toxins in the Darkshore wilds around Auberdine unnatural. Their effects on native wildlife and plants threaten the land's balance and point to a corrupting influence along the coast.

angles.text: As a druid, you begin with humble herbal work before receiving nature's magic to cleanse venom.
As a night elf, you undertake this trial in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. It reflects Kaldorei reverence for balance and care for their ancient forests.
